title: Astro Web Practices and Template Import

execution.reason: Registration RED evidence precedes source copying, which precedes integrated verification.

tasks.title: Qualify pinned Astro and pi.dev sources
tasks.description: Record exact source identities, compatible licenses, inventory, and safety caveats before importing files.
acceptance_criteria: Astro and pi.dev are pinned to exact 40-character commits with MIT license evidence.
The source inventory records seven skills and 24 examples.
Destructive instructions found in upstream maintainer references are documented as subordinate to Pi Core approval gates.
verification: test "$(find /home/ryanj/work/inspo/creative/web/astro/.agents/skills -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l)" -eq 7 && test "$(find /home/ryanj/work/inspo/creative/web/astro/examples -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l)" -eq 24
tasks.expected_verification_state: All identity and inventory checks exit zero; safety caveats remain explicit.

tasks.title: Copy Astro skills and duplicate the template library
tasks.description: Create the eight skill directories and the pinned Astro example mirror without overwriting existing paths.
acceptance_criteria: All seven upstream skill source files are copied byte-for-byte and each copied skill includes the MIT license.
All 24 Astro examples are duplicated recursively under .pi/templates/astro/examples.
The Pi-native Astro skill includes example-selection, semantic HTML, CSS, hydration, accessibility, and verification guidance.
The registration test fails before target creation for the intended missing-path reason and passes afterward.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="Astro upstream skills|manifest has exact bidirectional parity" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
tasks.expected_verification_state: The expected RED failure is retained, then all focused checks and source parity checks pass.

tasks.title: Verify Pi Core integration
tasks.description: Run repository gates and review owned paths while preserving concurrent work.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and full retained tests pass or any unrelated failure is reported without modification.
Doctor and every artifact task graph are checked.
Owned paths contain no deletion and no unrelated work is changed.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f" >/dev/null || exit; done
tasks.expected_verification_state: Applicable gates exit zero; unrelated dirty paths remain untouched and are not claimed as owned.
